desc: Indulge in the rich, decadent Milk Chocolate flavor of Betty Crocker Frosting with 25% less sugar than our Rich & Creamy Milk Chocolate Frosting (Sugar content has been reduced from 17g to 12g per serving. No reduction in calories). Betty Crocker Lower Sugar Frosting perfectly tops all your lower sugar cakes, cupcakes, brownies, cookies, and more while fitting dietary needs. Just open the tub, spread the chocolatey frosting, and serve. Or, customize creations with the addition of a cake decorating kit. Make this lower sugar frosting an irresistible addition to baked goods for birthday parties, office gatherings, or after dinner desserts. The tasty possibilities are endless. For more than a century, Betty Crocker has been a popular creator of simple, delicious recipes. Today, the Betty Crocker kitchen is still providing convenient, tasty dessert mixes, frostings, and convenient meal options and side dishes.
features:
LOWER SUGAR: A creamy lower sugar milk chocolate flavored frosting with 25% less sugar than our Betty Crocker Rich & Creamy Milk Chocolate Frosting (Sugar content has been reduced from 17g to 12g per serving. No reduction in calories)

QUICK AND EASY: Just pop open the tub, spread the frosting on cooled cake, and serve

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Use this frosting to cover lower sugar brownies, cookies, cupcakes, and pastries with creamy, chocolatey deliciousness

TRUSTED FAVORITE: Betty Crocker brings you trusted favorites you know and love; Try this frosting when baking Betty Crocker Low Sugar Baking Mixes

CONTAINS: One 15.75 oz tub of Betty Crocker Lower Sugar Milk Chocolate Flavored Frosting
ingredients: Sugar, Corn Starch, Water, Palm Oil, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Soluble Corn Fiber, Cocoa Processed with Alkali. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Monoglycerides, Polysorbate 60, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Citric Acid, Natural and Artificial Flavor. Freshness Preserved by Potassium Sorbate.
